Top Run-Getters in South Africa-Australia 2026 ODI Series

South Africa secured a 2-1 victory over Australia in their three-match 2026 ODI series. Australian captain Mitchell Marsh topped the run-scoring charts, accumulating 200 runs across three innings at a strike rate of 152.67. South African batter Matthew Breetzke followed in second place with 171 runs, including a century in the opening match at Durban. David Miller ranked third with 151 runs, highlighted by a career-best 142 off 93 balls in the second ODI at Johannesburg. While South Africa dominated the first two games, Australia claimed a consolation win in the rain-affected third match in Potchefstroom via the DLS method. Keshav Maharaj was named Player of the Series.

Chepauk Stadium to Honor Cricket Legends with Dedicated Stands

The M.A. Chidambaram Stadium, affectionately known as Chepauk, is set to immortalize three of Tamil Nadu's most celebrated cricket figures by dedicating stands in their names. The Tamil Nadu Cricket Association (TNCA) has announced plans to honor these stalwarts, recognizing their immense contributions to the sport.

This move will see stands at the iconic Chennai venue named after Ravichandran Ashwin, Kris Srikkanth, and S. Venkataraghavan. Each of these cricketers has left an indelible mark on Indian and international cricket, bringing glory and recognition to their home state.

Ravichandran Ashwin, a contemporary spin wizard, continues to be a pivotal player for India in Test cricket, known for his guile and record-breaking performances. His career has seen him become one of the most successful bowlers in the history of the game.

Kris Srikkanth, a flamboyant opening batsman, captivated fans with his aggressive style during the 1980s and early 90s. He was a key member of India's 1983 World Cup-winning squad and later served as a national selector.

S. Venkataraghavan, a classical off-spinner, was part of India's famous spin quartet of the 1970s. He also captained India and had a distinguished career as an international umpire, further cementing his legacy in cricket.

The dedication of these stands will serve as a permanent tribute to their achievements and inspire future generations of cricketers from Tamil Nadu. It's a fitting recognition at a stadium that has witnessed many of their memorable performances.
